note: One source of truth for every playable channel. Palettes are lifted verbatim from each channel's own CSS custom properties, not chosen here. 'mominc' is deliberately absent: it is the network hub and narrative front door, not a game. `roots`/`hide` drive play-route isolation (see tv/mount.js). `live` and `identity_api` are OFF switches: every live-mission and identity element on a landing card renders only when its value here is non-empty, so an unconfirmed broadcast can never produce an invented deadline and no form can collect an address there is nowhere to send. Durations are estimates and are flagged as such until a timed pass is run.

games.title: Living Small
games.premise: A museum that explains why your home got smaller, and calls it therapy.
games.does: Walk past six exhibits, turn around, walk back
games.teaser: Residential Compression is a MOM Inc programme. Six rooms, photographed twice: once the way the brochure shows them, once the way they are. Both photographs are real.
games.finish: Reach the door, then walk back out
games.profile_intro: THE COACH CANNOT DESIGN FOR A ROOM IT HAS NOT SEEN.
profile_questions: Where would you usually train: home, gym, outdoors, somewhere else, or not sure yet?
How much clear floor space do you actually have?
What equipment is available to you right now? None is a complete answer.

games.title: The Music Desk
games.premise: THE HAND does dishes, laundry and a passable set. MOM Inc would like you to notice the first two.
games.does: Watch the advert, scratch the record three times
games.teaser: Every appliance in this catalogue was somebody once. The advert is warm about it. Scratch the record three times and the warmth drops out for a second, which is the second worth staying for.
games.profile_intro: SET THE VOICE BEFORE MOM SETS IT FOR YOU.
profile_questions: What reliably gets you to start: a deadline, a person, music, a checklist, a joke, or something else?
How should your coach speak to you: direct, calm, warm, funny, quiet, or a mix?
What should your coach never say to you?

games.title: Basset's Assets
games.premise: Four lots, taken against somebody's debt, sold to you one door at a time. The fifth door is not for sale.
games.does: Turn the wheel, buy four lots, open the fifth
games.teaser: Four doors are business. The fifth is dinner. Bid through the fake lots, and Sag will show you what every broke goon keeps behind the last shutter.
games.finish: Buy four fake lots and open the fifth door
profile_questions: What can you comfortably spend on training each month, including zero?
What will you not spend money on?
Should the coach prefer what you own, second-hand options, or new gear when it suggests anything?

games.title: The Hall Of The Hand
games.premise: Choose a fighter, answer three five-question quizzes, and reach the exit. Every move you make, the Hand makes one too.
games.does: Take turns: move, look back, answer the gates
games.teaser: Coach Armie takes the Workout of the Day. He has counted your fingers and he did not like the number. The hall is long, the carpet is gold, and he is not the thing behind you.
games.finish: Reach the exit and see Armie's verdict
games.profile_intro: ARMIE NEED REAL STARTING POINT. WRITE IT DOWN FOR YOURSELF.
profile_questions: What movement do you do in a normal week right now?
What movement have you done before, even if you stopped?
Any injury, pain, disability or other limit the coach should work around? This is context, not a diagnosis.

games.title: The School Hunt
games.premise: Nine pages are loose across a school, a food-service floor and an office. The paper man moves when you look away.
games.teaser: They moved the morning again. The sun came up four minutes early and nobody filed it. The corgi knows, the corgi always knows, and the corgi cannot type, so the pages will have to do.
games.finish: Find nine pages across three rounds
games.profile_intro: THE ANCHOR NEEDS THREE FACTS. THEY ARE NOT HEADLINES.
profile_questions: How many hours do you usually sleep on a normal night?
How heavy is your stress load this week: light, manageable, heavy, or prefer not to say?
How much news do you take in on a normal day: none, under 30 minutes, 30 to 90 minutes, or more?

games.title: Build Your Stack
games.premise: Turn the tub, drop the scoop, seal a pre workout nobody has ever brewed.
games.does: Set six additives, pick a flavour, seal the can
games.teaser: UNTESTED. That word runs along the top and the bottom of the page because it is true. Six additives, eight flavours, one can, and not one of these blends has ever been made. Yours would be the first.
games.finish: Set six additives, choose a flavour, seal the can
games.profile_intro: YOUR BODY. YOUR SETTINGS. NOTHING IS PRE-MIXED.
profile_questions: How does caffeine usually hit you: fine, jittery, anxious, sleepless, or you do not use it?
Which supplements do you already take, if any?
When do you usually train: morning, afternoon, evening, or it moves around?

games.title: Goon
games.premise: Slide the tiles together. A goon is someone who gives. You are one too.
games.teaser: Every merge raises the pledge. The crowd loves a giver right up until the giver stops. Reach 2048 or fill the board; MOM has an ending ready either way.
games.profile_intro: A COACH SHOULD KNOW WHO IS ACTUALLY IN THE ROOM.
profile_questions: Who, if anyone, supports what you are trying to do?
Should the coach involve them, remind you about them, or keep the plan between you and the coach?
When do you reliably have help, company or accountability?

games.title: The Manufacturing Floor
games.premise: Six tubes of somebody's research go into one pitcher. What comes out is moulded, boxed and flown away. She leaves the goggles behind.
games.does: Pour six tubes, mould the unit, take the goggles
games.teaser: Six labelled tubes. One pitcher. Purple goo, a mould, a box, and one pair of goggles left on the line for only a few seconds. She will not click them for you.
games.finish: Grab the goggles before the drone
games.profile_intro: PUT THE BELIEF AND THE SOURCE IN SEPARATE TUBES.
profile_questions: What health or fitness advice do you already believe?
Where did that advice come from?
How confident are you checking a claim against its original source: not yet, sometimes, usually, or very?
